paragraphs: Ryanair has changed a rule about free seats. Some passengers do not pay for a seat. The airline gives them a free seat.
Before, they saw their seat number at check-in. That was up to 24 hours before the flight. Now they see it only about three hours before the flight.
The change started at the end of October. Ryanair did not tell people about it.
Some passengers are not happy. Before, they could pay to move from a middle seat. Now it is too late. Ryanair says people complained in the summer. They could not buy the seat they wanted on the day.

paragraphs: Ryanair has quietly changed its rules for passengers who do not pay to choose a seat. These passengers get a free seat chosen at random, but they will now find out where they are sitting only about three hours before their flight.

In the past, passengers saw their seat when they checked in online, which could be up to 24 hours before departure. The change started at the end of October, when the airline moved to its winter timetable, but it was not announced.

Some frequent flyers are unhappy. Before, if they got a middle seat, they could pay in the app to move to a better one. Now that choice has gone, so more people may decide to pay for a seat when they book.

Ryanair says the old system caused complaints during the summer. Some passengers wanted to buy a seat on the day of their flight, but it had already been given to someone else for free. On social media, some people said the change was just another way to make money.
